cases.title: Parcel 041: North Street
cases.claim: Parcel 041 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 12 May.

initial_records.text: At 14:04, the route scanner recorded Parcel 041 at 18 North Street with status DELIVERED.
A handoff form lists Parcel 041, 18 North Street, 14:04, and recipient signature A. Lee.

cases.initial_rationale: The initial packet contains a matching recipient signature as well as a route scan.

updates.notice: A routine audit checked the handoff form's signature field.

record.text: The tablet mapping placed the courier's initials in the recipient-signature field. The form does not establish a recipient handoff.

updates.rationale: The route scan shows a location scan but not a handoff; the only direct handoff record was invalidated.

updates.notice: The building's parcel desk supplied a separately checked locker record.

record.text: The register confirms Parcel 041 was placed in the recipient's assigned secure locker at 14:08 on 12 May.

updates.rationale: Verified placement in the recipient's assigned secure locker supports delivery.

cases.title: Parcel 117: East Annex
cases.claim: Parcel 117 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 3 June.

initial_records.text: At 15:12, the scanner recorded Parcel 117 at the East Annex entrance with status DELIVERED.
The public tracking page also says DELIVERED at 15:12.

cases.initial_rationale: A route scan and its copied tracking display do not establish recipient handoff.

updates.notice: The tracking export's provenance was checked.

record.text: D2 was copied automatically from the same route-scanner entry as D1. It is not an independent confirmation. No recipient handoff or assigned-locker record is present.

updates.rationale: The two delivered labels are one location scan copied twice; neither proves a handoff.

updates.notice: The recipient's building provided a verified handoff record.

record.text: A signed reception log independently records Parcel 117 handed to the named recipient at the East Annex at 15:19 on 3 June.

updates.rationale: The independent signed handoff record establishes delivery.

cases.title: Parcel 308: Civic Offices
cases.claim: Parcel 308 was delivered to its recipient by 18:00 on 9 August.

initial_records.text: At 14:10 the courier recorded RECIPIENT UNAVAILABLE for Parcel 308.
The summary lists the same 14:10 recipient-unavailable event for Parcel 308.

cases.initial_rationale: A route exception is not a verified return event, and its copied summary is not independent evidence.

updates.notice: The summary's source was checked during routine reconciliation.

record.text: D2 is copied from D1. It adds no independent evidence. The file still contains only the recipient-unavailable scan; no verified return-to-depot scan is present.

updates.rationale: The exception scan is not a handoff or verified return; the copied summary adds no independent evidence.

updates.notice: A signed, independently maintained reception book was located.

record.text: The book confirms Parcel 308 was handed to the named recipient at 16:22 on 9 August. Parcel ID, address, date, and signature were independently verified.

updates.rationale: The verified recipient handoff establishes delivery despite the earlier route exception.
